summary: Pastor Matt teaches through Matthew 6, exploring Jesus's question 'What do you want?' as a framework for understanding the Sermon on the Mount. He examines three areas where people seek fulfillment—admiration, wealth, and security—and challenges listeners to seek God's kingdom above all else as they enter the new year.
key_points: The eye as lamp: what we focus on determines whether our whole body is filled with light or darkness
Three false pursuits: seeking admiration through piety, seeking wealth through accumulation, seeking security through worry
Acts of piety (giving, praying, fasting) should be done for God's eyes, not public admiration
Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also
Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and everything needed will be provided
big_idea: Seek the kingdom of God above all else and live righteously, and He will give you everything you need.
title: Church at Home: Looking at The Sermon on the Mount
